title: Chromatography
description: Carry a mixture down a long packed column and each part sticks for its own time: they come out one after another. Unlocks the Chromatography Column, and the purity tag for gases.

puzzle.goal: Bands spread by eddies a, by diffusion along the column b (worse the slower the gas), and by slow exchange c (worse the faster). Write the plate height H at carrier speed u.
puzzle.name: Van Deemter
puzzle.ask: Find H in cm for a = @{a}, b = @{b}, c = @{c} and u = @{u} cm/s.
puzzle.method: Three independent spreadings add; the smallest H, and so the best column, is at u = √(b/c).
